model.name: Swarmchestrate · k3s metrics → EMS → OptimusDB trust evidence
model.documentation: End-to-end architecture of the k3s Metrics Gateway (host A), the EMS metrics sidecar (host B) and the persistence of trust attributes A1 Availability and A3 Operational stability in OptimusDB (dstype kbtrust). Horizon Europe Swarmchestrate, Grant 101135012.

element.name: Trustworthy swarm orchestration across the Cloud-to-Edge continuum
Trust-aware placement and coordinator election in Swarmchestrate
Hosts expose only 22 / 80 / 443: all traffic goes through Traefik on port 80
element.documentation: Host B (EMS) answers on 22, 80 and 443 only. The gateway is pulled by host B over HTTP :80, and OptimusDB is written over HTTP :80. No new port is opened.

element.name: k3s out of the box: A1 Availability and A3 Operational stability are measurable now; the other attributes are partial (raw inputs) or need extra tooling
element.documentation: From the Swarmchestrate Trust Attributes Catalogue, column 'Out of the box (k3s Metrics Gateway)': Yes: A3, B3. Partial: A1, A2, A4, B2, B4, B5, C2, C4, E2, G1. No: the rest. Persisted as trust evidence: A1 and A3.

element.name: A1 Availability ≥ 99.5 % in 30 days
element.documentation: Catalogue A1. Available time / scheduled time; successful checks / expected checks. Role in TMS: conditional or calculable. Missing checks are not counted as available (see evidence.coverage).

element.name: A3 Operational stability ≤ 2 unplanned restarts in 7 days
element.documentation: Catalogue A3. Unexpected restarts, crashes and container failure events. Role in TMS: calculable. Planned replacements (rollouts) create a new pod and are not counted.

element.name: Trust evaluation: trust scores, Trust VCs, coordinator election
Swarmchestrate Trust Attributes Catalogue (A1 to G4)
optimusTrust / TMS (optimusPy client)
element.documentation: Reads trust evidence from kbtrust (crudget by criteria) and computes trust scores and VCs.

element.name: OptimusDB agents optimusdb1, optimusdb2, optimusdb3 (ns optimusddc)
element.documentation: Decentralised knowledge base (OrbitDB/IPFS, CRDT replication). Coordinator plus 2 followers.

element.name: Command API POST /optimusdb1/swarmkb/command
element.documentation: crudput / crudget / crudupdate / cruddelete with dstype and criteria. Reached through Traefik :80.

element.name: kbtrust: trust_evidence (A1, A3) · trust_evidence_history · monitoring_snapshot
element.documentation: _id trust:<cluster>:<kind>:<ns>/<name>:<A1|A3> (upsert every 60 s); history copy per hour; monitoring:<cluster>:<kind>:<ns>/<name> in the optimusTrust monitoring shape.

element.name: swch-metrics-gateway (ns swarm-system) :8000
element.documentation: FastAPI gateway over metrics-server, kubelet (Summary, cAdvisor, resource, probes), core API state, events and API-server metrics/health. Publishes the topology ConfigMap.

element.name: Read and normalise k3s metrics and state (pods, nodes, events, control plane)
k3s v1.33.4: kube-apiserver :6443 · kubelet / cAdvisor · metrics-server
autossh tunnel to the EMS broker (SSH :22)
Trust inputs. A1: pod_running · node_ready · apiserver_readyz. A3: pod_restarts · ready→not-ready · k8s_event Warnings
element.documentation: All swch_k3s_* samples that are already collected for EMS. Warning reasons used as A3 evidence: BackOff, OOMKilling, Unhealthy, Failed, Evicted, Rebooted, NodeNotReady.

element.name: Collectors: pod_overview 60 s · topology 2 min · control-plane 30 s · events 60 s · node / pod usage 30 s
OptimusDB trust sink: A1 / A3 evaluator, rolling 30 d / 7 d, flush every 60 s
element.documentation: optimusdb_trust sink (v0.2.0). Hourly buckets per subject (pod, node, control plane). Writes with crudput into dstype kbtrust.

element.name: ICCS network · HTTP :80 (host B → host A) · SSH :22 (autossh)
Evaluate A1 Availability = available checks / observed checks over 30 d
element.documentation: Per pod (pod_running), node (node_ready) and control plane (apiserver_readyz). score = value. slo_met = value >= availability_slo (0.995). evidence: checks_ok, checks_total, coverage.

element.name: Evaluate A3 Operational stability = unplanned restarts / outages over 7 d
element.documentation: Pods: increase of the container restart counter. Nodes and control plane: ready→not-ready transitions. Warning events are attached as evidence. score = max(0, 1 - n / (max + 1)); slo_met = n <= 2.

element.name: trust_evidence A1 {value, score, slo_met, evidence.checks, coverage, subject_did}
trust_evidence A3 {value, score, slo_met, evidence.unplanned_events, warnings}
